title: Commutating morphism record
description: Morphism: a Heyting algebra with two nuclei (sigma = saturating, delta = transferring) -> the commutative nuclear square with derived composite pi and the four corner cells. Verifies sigma and delta are nuclei and CHECKS the commutativity axiom sigma . delta = delta . sigma (not derivable from the nuclei alone); on success derives pi = sigma . delta, verifies it is a nucleus, and computes potential = A, active = Fix(sigma), stable = Fix(delta), absurd = A* = Fix(sigma) cap Fix(delta) = Fix(pi). saturating and transferring are the generators commutating combines; commutativity is the irreducible axiom it adds.
